# Principals and endpoints files

Infra writes two files for the active platform at every deployment, in `/etc/pinka/platform/` (0644 root). A platform reads names, UIDs, socket paths, addresses and ports from them instead of hard-coding any of them ([Integration contract](../contracts.md#sockets-principals-and-endpoints)). Their JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) are published with the contract, in `contract/principals.schema.json` and `contract/endpoints.schema.json`; the schema of `endpoints.toml` describes the parsed TOML document. Each example is rendered for the reference platform (`tests/reference-platform/platform-manifest.yaml`) on a full node with the default ports.

## principals.json

The principals of the active platform, /etc/pinka/platform/principals.json (contract v2): every service and job with its account and UID, every socket with its path and allowed clients, and the groups of the human classes. Written by infra at every deployment, 0644 root. The platform builds its per-endpoint peer allowlists from this file instead of hard-coding names. Schema file: `contract/principals.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `_comment` | string | yes | The notice that infra manages the file; ignore it. |
| `schema_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this file's format. |
| `contract_version` | constant `2` | yes | Contract version of the installed infra. |
| `platform` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `groups` | object | yes | The Unix group of each human class a socket can name. |
| `groups.admins` | string | yes | Group of the admins (`pinka-admin`). |
| `groups.researchers` | string | yes | Group of every researcher (`pinka`). |
| `services` | array | yes | Every service, in manifest order. |
| `services[].name` | string | yes | Name of the service or job in the manifest. |
| `services[].profile` | one of `controller`, `inference-broker`, `sandbox-operator`, `restricted-operator`, `restricted-reader`, `observer`, `untrusted-agent` | yes | Its privilege profile. |
| `services[].account` | string | yes | Its Unix account, `<platform>-<name>`. |
| `services[].uid` | integer | yes | The account's UID, in infra's platform UID range. |
| `services[].config` | string or null | yes | Its non-secret configuration file, `/etc/pinka/platform/config/<service>.json`, when the manifest declares `config`; otherwise null. |
| `services[].secrets_dir` | string or null | yes | Its secrets directory, `/etc/pinka/secrets/<account>/`, one file per declared secret, when the manifest declares `secrets`; otherwise null. |
| `services[].state` | object | yes | Its state directories: the name the manifest declares, mapped to the directory below `/srv/pinka/platforms/<platform>/state/<service>/`. |
| `services[].state.*` | string | no | any key; value as described |
| `jobs` | array | yes | Every training job, in manifest order. |
| `jobs[].name` | string | yes | Name of the service or job in the manifest. |
| `jobs[].profile` | constant `gpu-trainer` | yes | Its privilege profile, always `gpu-trainer`. |
| `jobs[].account` | string | yes | Its Unix account, `<platform>-<name>`. |
| `jobs[].uid` | integer | yes | The account's UID, in infra's platform UID range. |
| `sockets` | array | yes | Every socket, in manifest order. |
| `sockets[].service` | string | yes | The serving service. |
| `sockets[].name` | string | yes | Socket name in the manifest. |
| `sockets[].path` | string | yes | The socket, `/run/pinka/platform/<service>/<socket>.sock`. |
| `sockets[].owner` | string | yes | The serving service's account, which owns the socket. |
| `sockets[].group` | string | yes | The socket's client group, `<platform>-<service>-<socket>`. |
| `sockets[].mode` | constant `0660` | yes | The socket's mode. |
| `sockets[].fd_name` | string | yes | The name systemd passes the socket under (`LISTEN_FDNAMES`); the service takes the socket from systemd and never creates it. |
| `sockets[].agent_dedicated` | boolean | yes | Whether the socket is dedicated to the agent (`untrusted_clients: true`): `untrusted-agent` is then its only client, and no endpoint on it may return restricted data. |
| `sockets[].clients` | object | yes | Who may connect: build the socket's peer-credential allowlist from these. |
| `sockets[].clients.profiles` | array | yes | The client profiles the manifest names. |
| `sockets[].clients.accounts` | array | yes | The accounts of the services with those profiles, sorted; the members of the socket's group. |
| `sockets[].clients.humans` | array | yes | The human classes the manifest names. |
| `sockets[].clients.human_groups` | array | yes | Their groups, in the same order; each gets a POSIX ACL entry on the socket. |
| `sockets[].clients.root` | boolean | yes | Whether the manifest names `root` as a client (root can always connect, for the hooks). |

Example:

```json
{
  "_comment": "Managed by pinka (principals.json, contract v2 §12.3). Local changes will be overwritten.",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "contract_version": 2,
  "platform": "refplat",
  "groups": {
    "admins": "pinka-admin",
    "researchers": "pinka"
  },
  "services": [
    {
      "name": "ctl",
      "profile": "controller",
      "account": "refplat-ctl",
      "uid": 60578,
      "config": "/etc/pinka/platform/config/ctl.json",
      "secrets_dir": "/etc/pinka/secrets/refplat-ctl",
      "state": {
        "records": "/srv/pinka/platforms/refplat/state/ctl/records",
        "datasets": "/srv/pinka/platforms/refplat/state/ctl/datasets"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "agent",
      "profile": "untrusted-agent",
      "account": "refplat-agent",
      "uid": 60579,
      "config": null,
      "secrets_dir": null,
      "state": {}
    },
    {
      "name": "broker",
      "profile": "inference-broker",
      "account": "refplat-broker",
      "uid": 60580,
      "config": null,
      "secrets_dir": null,
      "state": {}
    }
  ],
  "jobs": [
    {
      "name": "tune",
      "profile": "gpu-trainer",
      "account": "refplat-tune",
      "uid": 60581
    },
    {
      "name": "tunecpu",
      "profile": "gpu-trainer",
      "account": "refplat-tunecpu",
      "uid": 60582
    }
  ],
  "sockets": [
    {
      "service": "ctl",
      "name": "api",
      "path": "/run/pinka/platform/ctl/api.sock",
      "owner": "refplat-ctl",
      "group": "refplat-ctl-api",
      "mode": "0660",
      "fd_name": "api",
      "agent_dedicated": false,
      "clients": {
        "profiles": [],
        "accounts": [],
        "humans": [
          "researchers"
        ],
        "human_groups": [
          "pinka"
        ],
        "root": true
      }
    },
    {
      "service": "ctl",
      "name": "session",
      "path": "/run/pinka/platform/ctl/session.sock",
      "owner": "refplat-ctl",
      "group": "refplat-ctl-session",
      "mode": "0660",
      "fd_name": "session",
      "agent_dedicated": true,
      "clients": {
        "profiles": [
          "untrusted-agent"
        ],
        "accounts": [
          "refplat-agent"
        ],
        "humans": [],
        "human_groups": [],
        "root": false
      }
    },
    {
      "service": "broker",
      "name": "infer",
      "path": "/run/pinka/platform/broker/infer.sock",
      "owner": "refplat-broker",
      "group": "refplat-broker-infer",
      "mode": "0660",
      "fd_name": "infer",
      "agent_dedicated": false,
      "clients": {
        "profiles": [],
        "accounts": [],
        "humans": [
          "researchers"
        ],
        "human_groups": [
          "pinka"
        ],
        "root": true
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## endpoints.toml

The addresses and paths infra provides to the active platform, /etc/pinka/platform/endpoints.toml (contract v2), with the effective ports. Written by infra at every deployment, 0644 root; the schema describes the parsed TOML document. A facility's table is present only when the manifest's `requires` names it; the platform reads names and addresses from here instead of hard-coding them. Schema file: `contract/endpoints.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this file's format. |
| `platform` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `lab` | object | yes | The lab facts. |
| `lab.machine` | string | yes | The machine's name (`machine_name`). |
| `lab.lab_mode` | one of `production`, `staging` | yes | `production` or `staging`. |
| `lab.node_role` | one of `full`, `lab`, `inference` | yes | `full`, `lab` or `inference`. |
| `postgres` | object | no | With `requires: [postgres]`. |
| `postgres.socket_dir` | string | yes | Socket directory of the service roles (group `<platform>-db`). |
| `postgres.reader_socket_dir` | string | yes | Socket directory of the researchers' reader role and Grafana (group `pinka`). |
| `postgres.database` | string | yes | The platform's database, named after the platform. |
| `postgres.migrator_role` | string | yes | Owner of the schemas, used only by the `migrate` hook (`<platform>_migrator`). |
| `postgres.reader_role` | string | yes | The researchers' read-only role (`<platform>_reader`); never `restricted`. |
| `postgres.grafana_role` | string | yes | Grafana's read-only role (`<platform>_grafana`); never `restricted`. |
| `postgres.roles` | object | yes | The login role of every service except `untrusted-agent`, by service name (`<platform>_<service>`); its password file is `/etc/pinka/secrets/postgres/<role>`. |
| `postgres.roles.*` | string | no | any key; value as described |
| `telemetry` | object | no | With `requires: [telemetry]`. |
| `telemetry.otlp_grpc` | string | yes | OTLP gRPC for services, on loopback. |
| `telemetry.otlp_http` | string | yes | OTLP HTTP for services, on loopback. |
| `telemetry.vm_collector_grpc` | string | yes | OTLP gRPC for VM targets, on `vm_collector_address`. |
| `telemetry.vm_collector_http` | string | yes | OTLP HTTP for VM targets, on `vm_collector_address`. |
| `telemetry.agent_otlp_socket` | string | yes | The agent's OTLP socket; everything received there is stamped `pinka.trust=untrusted`. |
| `telemetry.query_socket` | string | yes | The read-only query proxy for Prometheus, Loki and Tempo. |
| `inference` | object | no | With `requires: [inference]`. |
| `inference.mode` | one of `local`, `remote`, `scripted` | yes | `local` (vLLM on this node), `remote` (the inference forwarder to a paired inference node) or `scripted` (only with `lab_mode = "staging"`; never official). |
| `inference.researcher_endpoint` | string | yes | The inference broker's researcher endpoint, the only TCP port a platform may listen on. |
| `inference.api_url` | string | yes | The OpenAI-compatible inference API: vLLM, the forwarder's loopback port, or the configured scripted endpoint. |
| `inference.control_url` | string | no | With `remote`: the forwarder's control API on loopback. |
| `opa` | object | no | With `requires: [opa]`. |
| `opa.url` | string | yes | The OPA decision API on loopback. |
| `opa.decision_path` | string | no | The decision path of the manifest's `policy`, below `/v1/data/`, when the manifest has one. |
| `incus` | object | no | With `requires: [incus]`. |
| `incus.url` | string | yes | The Incus HTTPS API on loopback. |
| `incus.cert_dir` | string | yes | Directory of the client certificates, `<cert_dir>/<account>/{client.crt,client.key,server.crt}`. |
| `incus.projects` | array | yes | The Incus projects of the platform (`bench`, `build`). |
| `incus.run_network_socket` | string | yes | The run-network helper, for the controller only. |
| `incus.cpuset_targets` | string | no | The CPUs of the target instances (a Linux cpuset list), when `cpuset_targets` is set; every target's `limits.cpu` is a range inside it. |
| `gpu` | object | no | With `requires: [gpu]`. |
| `gpu.arbiter_socket` | string | yes | The GPU arbiter's socket, for the controller only. |
| `signing` | object | yes | The signing key. |
| `signing.key_file` | string | yes | The platform's ed25519 signing key (PEM PKCS#8), 0400 for its controller. |
| `signing.public_key_file` | string | yes | Its public key (PEM SubjectPublicKeyInfo). |
| `signing.published_keys_dir` | string | yes | Where the public keys are published as `<platform>-<machine>-<YYYYMMDD>.pub` and kept forever. |
| `attestations` | object | yes | The attestation directories; the format and the official check are the platform's. |
| `attestations.trusted_keys_dir` | string | yes | Trusted public keys of external verification (PEM). |
| `attestations.attestations_dir` | string | yes | Attestations and their detached signatures. |
| `sessions` | object | yes | Session records and the fingerprint. |
| `sessions.records_dir` | string | yes | The session records, one `<boot_id>.json` per boot. |
| `sessions.fingerprint_command` | array | yes | The command that prints the fingerprint document. |
| `ports` | object | yes | The effective listener ports, by the names of the port table: the defaults with the machine's `ports:` overrides. |
| `ports.*` | integer | no | any key; value as described |

Example:

```toml
# Managed by pinka (endpoints.toml, contract v2 §12.3). Local changes will be overwritten.
# The addresses and paths infra provides to the platform, with the effective ports.
schema_version = 1
platform = "refplat"

[lab]
machine = "pinka-lab"
lab_mode = "production"
node_role = "full"

[postgres]
socket_dir = "/run/pinka/postgres"
reader_socket_dir = "/run/pinka/postgres-reader"
database = "refplat"
migrator_role = "refplat_migrator"
reader_role = "refplat_reader"
grafana_role = "refplat_grafana"

[postgres.roles]
ctl = "refplat_ctl"
broker = "refplat_broker"

[telemetry]
otlp_grpc = "127.0.0.1:4317"
otlp_http = "127.0.0.1:4318"
vm_collector_grpc = "198.18.0.1:4317"
vm_collector_http = "198.18.0.1:4318"
agent_otlp_socket = "/run/pinka/otlp/agent.sock"
query_socket = "/run/pinka/query.sock"

[inference]
mode = "local"
researcher_endpoint = "127.0.0.1:18705"
api_url = "http://127.0.0.1:18704"

[gpu]
arbiter_socket = "/run/pinka/gpu.sock"

[signing]
key_file = "/etc/pinka/signing/refplat/signing.key"
public_key_file = "/etc/pinka/signing/refplat/signing.pub"
published_keys_dir = "/srv/pinka/shared/signing-keys"

[attestations]
trusted_keys_dir = "/etc/pinka/qa/trusted-keys"
attestations_dir = "/etc/pinka/qa/attestations"

[sessions]
records_dir = "/var/lib/pinka/sessions"
fingerprint_command = ["pinka", "fingerprint", "--json"]

[ports]
docs_serve = 18706
gateway_adhoc = 18705
grafana = 18700
incus_https = 8443
inference_control = 18710
loki = 18702
opa = 8181
otlp_grpc = 4317
otlp_http = 4318
prometheus = 18701
tempo = 18703
vllm = 18704
```
